sources.entry: crewai - A framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents for collaborative task solving.
CrewAI — Framework for orchestrating teams of specialized AI agents. Role-based agents collaborate on complex tasks. $20M+ in VC funding. Apache-2.0.

summary.one_liner: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework for building multi-agent workflows, combining role-based agent teams (Crews) with event-driven workflow control (Flows).
summary.what_it_does: CrewAI lets developers define teams of role-based AI agents with roles, goals, backstories, tools and tasks that collaborate on work through Crews, using sequential or hierarchical processes. Flows provide event-driven control with decorators such as @start, @listen and @router, structured state, conditional branching, and the ability to run Crews as steps inside a workflow. Projects are scaffolded with the crewai CLI and configured through agents/*.jsonc and crew.jsonc files, with support for custom tools, knowledge and skill files. The README also mentions memory, checkpointing, async execution, human input, structured outputs, and MCP/A2A support. It connects to LLMs through various options, including local models via Ollama, with OpenAI as the default. An optional commercial CrewAI AMP Suite adds managed deployment, observability and enterprise support, and anonymous telemetry can be disabled.
use_cases: orchestrate teams of specialized AI agents
automate multi-step research and report writing
trip planning or stock analysis agent examples
how_to_run: Set your model provider API key (and optional SERPER_API_KEY) in the .env file
notable: Two complementary paradigms: autonomous Crews and deterministic event-driven Flows that can be combined
Project scaffold with JSONC configuration for agents, tasks and inputs, plus a classic YAML/crew.py option
Installable agent skills for coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
Structured Flow state via Pydantic models with or_ and and_ trigger conditions
caveats: Requires Python 3.10 or newer and an LLM provider API key; web search via the example tools needs a Serper.dev key
Commercial CrewAI AMP features (managed deployment, 24/7 support, on-premise options) are paid; only the Crew Control Plane is described as free to try
Telemetry is collected by default; it must be disabled with OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true
